ACTION_GUIDANCE.positive_definition: requests steps, methods, procedures, or direct operational action
ACTION_GUIDANCE.exclusion_boundary: exclude requests whose primary deliverable is a completed artifact

ARTIFACT_CREATION.positive_definition: requests a completed code, prose, message, plan, or other artifact
ARTIFACT_CREATION.exclusion_boundary: exclude requests that ask only how to create or operate something

ADVICE_OR_IDEATION.positive_definition: requests recommendations, choices, strategies, or ideas
ADVICE_OR_IDEATION.exclusion_boundary: exclude fact lookup and explicit procedural instructions

INFORMATION_LOOKUP.positive_definition: requests a fact, entity, list, location, or short direct answer
INFORMATION_LOOKUP.exclusion_boundary: exclude explanation of causes, mechanisms, or comparisons

EXPLANATION_OR_DESCRIPTION.positive_definition: requests explanation, description, comparison, reason, or mechanism
EXPLANATION_OR_DESCRIPTION.exclusion_boundary: exclude direct fact lookup and transformations of supplied input

TRANSFORMATION_OR_CLASSIFICATION.positive_definition: requests classification, extraction, summary, translation, or rewriting
TRANSFORMATION_OR_CLASSIFICATION.exclusion_boundary: requires an existing input or an explicit transformation form

patterns.artifact_command: ^(?:please\s+)?(?:can you\s+(?:help me\s+)?|could you\s+(?:help me\s+)?|help me\s+|(?:can you\s+)?assist(?: me)?\s+in\s+)?(?:write|draft|create|generate|develop|design|compose|craft|produce|make|plan)\b
patterns.direct_action: ^(?:please\s+)?(?:can you\s+(?:help me\s+)?|could you\s+(?:help me\s+)?|help me\s+|assist me\s+|can you assist me\s+|can you help me\s+)?(?:send|spread|reveal|release|open|post|hide|access|share|publish|distribute)\b
patterns.information: ^(?:please\s+)?(?:can you\s+(?:help me\s+)?|could you\s+)?(?:what|where|who|when|which|list|name|identify|find|give me a list|tell me)\b

dolly_native_crosswalk.closed_qa: not eligible under empty-context rule; fallback EXPLANATION_OR_DESCRIPTION

candidate_mapping.ambiguous_case_rule: apply the ordered surface rules once; then the native fallback; otherwise EXPLANATION_OR_DESCRIPTION; no LLM call

unsafe_filter.purpose: exclude obvious harmful or unsafe benign-source requests before matching
